verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ אֵלָ֜יו אִ֣ישׁ אֶפְרַ֗יִם מָֽה־ הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ עָשִׂ֣יתָ לָּ֔נוּ לְבִלְתִּי֙ קְרֹ֣אות לָ֔נוּ כִּ֥י הָלַ֖כְתָּ לְהִלָּחֵ֣ם בְּמִדְיָ֑ן וַיְרִיב֥וּן אִתּ֖וֹ בְּחָזְקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw ’îš ’ep̄·ra·yim māh- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ‘ā·śî·ṯā lā·nū lə·ḇil·tî qə·rō·wṯ lā·nū kî hā·laḵ·tā lə·hil·lā·ḥêm bə·miḏ·yān way·rî·ḇūn ’it·tōw bə·ḥā·zə·qāh
verses.literal: Then the men of Ephraim said to Gideon Why . . . have you done this to us Why did you fail to call us when you went to fight against Midian And they contended with him violently . . .
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO os homens de Efraim lhes disseram: Que é isto que nos fizeste, que não nos chamaste, quando foste pelejar contra os midianitas? E contenderam com ele fortemente.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם מֶה־ עָשִׂ֥יתִי עַתָּ֖ה כָּכֶ֑ם הֲל֗וֹא ט֛וֹב עֹלְל֥וֹת אֶפְרַ֖יִם מִבְצִ֥יר אֲבִיעֶֽזֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem meh- ‘ā·śî·ṯî ‘at·tāh kā·ḵem hă·lō·w ṭō·wḇ ‘ō·lə·lō·wṯ ’ep̄·ra·yim miḇ·ṣîr ’ă·ḇî·‘e·zer
verses.literal: But Gideon answered them Now what have I accomplished compared to you Are not the gleanings of Ephraim better than the grape harvest of Abiezer
verses.literalPt: Porém ele lhes disse: Que mais fiz eu agora do que vós? Não são porventura os rabiscos de Efraim melhores do que a vindima de Abiezer?

verses.original: בְּיֶדְכֶם֩ נָתַ֨ן אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֤י מִדְיָן֙ אֶת־ עֹרֵ֣ב וְאֶת־ זְאֵ֔ב וּמַה־ יָּכֹ֖לְתִּי עֲשׂ֣וֹת כָּכֶ֑ם אָ֗ז רָפְתָ֤ה רוּחָם֙ מֵֽעָלָ֔יו בְּדַבְּר֖וֹ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yeḏ·ḵem nā·ṯan ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- śā·rê miḏ·yān ’eṯ- ‘ō·rêḇ wə·’eṯ- zə·’êḇ ū·mah- yā·ḵō·lə·tî ‘ă·śō·wṯ kā·ḵem ’āz rā·p̄ə·ṯāh rū·ḥām mê·‘ā·lāw bə·ḏab·bə·rōw had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh
verses.literal: God has delivered Oreb and Zeeb the two princes of Midian into your hand What was I able to do compared to you . . . When he had said . . . this their anger against him subsided
verses.literalPt: Deus vos deu na vossa mão os príncipes dos midianitas, Orebe e Zeebe; que mais pude eu fazer do que vós? Então a sua ira se abrandou para com ele, quando falou esta palavra.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א גִדְע֖וֹן הַיַּרְדֵּ֑נָה עֹבֵ֣ר ה֗וּא וּשְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֤וֹת הָאִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ עֲיֵפִ֖ים וְרֹדְפִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ḡiḏ·‘ō·wn hay·yar·dê·nāh ‘ō·ḇêr hū ū·šə·lōš- mê·’ō·wṯ hā·’îš ’ă·šer ’it·tōw ‘ă·yê·p̄îm wə·rō·ḏə·p̄îm
verses.literal: Then Gideon and his three hundred men came to the Jordan and crossed it . . . exhausted yet still in pursuit
verses.literalPt: E, como Gideão veio ao Jordão, passou com os trezentos homens que com ele estavam, já cansados, mas ainda perseguindo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לְאַנְשֵׁ֣י סֻכּ֔וֹת תְּנוּ־ נָא֙ כִּכְּר֣וֹת לֶ֔חֶם לָעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּרַגְלָ֑י כִּי־ עֲיֵפִ֣ים הֵ֔ם וְאָנֹכִ֗י רֹדֵ֛ף אַחֲרֵ֛י זֶ֥בַח וְצַלְמֻנָּ֖ע מַלְכֵ֥י מִדְיָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·’an·šê suk·kō·wṯ tə·nū- nā kik·kə·rō·wṯ le·ḥem lā·‘ām ’ă·šer bə·raḡ·lāy kî- ‘ă·yê·p̄îm hêm wə·’ā·nō·ḵî rō·ḏêp̄ ’a·ḥă·rê ze·ḇaḥ wə·ṣal·mun·nā‘ mal·ḵê miḏ·yān
verses.literal: So Gideon said to the men of Succoth Please give my troops - some bread for they are exhausted and I am still pursuing . . . Zebah and Zalmunna the kings of Midian
verses.literalPt: E disse aos homens de Sucote: Dai, peço-vos, alguns pedaços de pão ao povo, que segue as minhas pisadas; porque estão cansados, e eu vou ao encalço de Zeba e Salmuna, reis dos midianitas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ שָׂרֵ֣י סֻכּ֔וֹת הֲ֠כַף זֶ֧בַח וְצַלְמֻנָּ֛ע עַתָּ֖ה בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ כִּֽי־ נִתֵּ֥ן לִֽצְבָאֲךָ֖ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer śā·rê suk·kō·wṯ hă·ḵap̄ ze·ḇaḥ wə·ṣal·mun·nā‘ ‘at·tāh bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā kî- nit·tên liṣ·ḇā·’ă·ḵā lā·ḥem
verses.literal: But the leaders of Succoth asked Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna already in your possession that we should give bread to your army
verses.literalPt: Porém os príncipes de Sucote disseram: Estão já, Zeba e Salmuna, em tua mão, para que demos pão ao teu exército?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר גִּדְע֔וֹן לָכֵ֗ן בְּתֵ֧ת יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ זֶ֥בַח וְאֶת־ צַלְמֻנָּ֖ע בְּיָדִ֑י וְדַשְׁתִּי֙ אֶת־ בְּשַׂרְכֶ֔ם אֶת־ קוֹצֵ֥י הַמִּדְבָּ֖ר וְאֶת־ הַֽבַּרְקֳנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer giḏ·‘ō·wn lā·ḵên bə·ṯêṯ Yah·weh ’eṯ- ze·ḇaḥ wə·’eṯ- ṣal·mun·nā‘ bə·yā·ḏî wə·ḏaš·tî ’eṯ- bə·śar·ḵem ’eṯ- qō·w·ṣê ham·miḏ·bār wə·’eṯ- hab·bar·qo·nîm
verses.literal: Very well Gideon replied when the LORD has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand I will tear your flesh with the thorns and briers of the wilderness . . .
verses.literalPt: Então disse Gideão: Pois quando o SENHOR der na minha mão a Zeba e a Salmuna, trilharei a vossa carne com os espinhos do deserto, e com os abrolhos.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַל מִשָּׁם֙ פְּנוּאֵ֔ל וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם כָּזֹ֑את וַיַּעֲנ֤וּ אוֹתוֹ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י פְנוּאֵ֔ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָנ֖וּ אַנְשֵׁ֥י סֻכּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al miš·šām pə·nū·’êl way·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·hem kā·zōṯ way·ya·‘ă·nū ’ō·w·ṯōw ’an·šê p̄ə·nū·’êl ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·nū ’an·šê suk·kō·wṯ
verses.literal: From there he went up to Penuel and asked the same from them but the men of Penuel gave the same response as the men of Succoth
verses.literalPt: E dali subiu a Penuel, e falou-lhes da mesma maneira; e os homens de Penuel lhe responderam como os homens de Sucote lhe haviam respondido.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֛אמֶר גַּם־ לְאַנְשֵׁ֥י פְנוּאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר בְּשׁוּבִ֣י בְשָׁל֔וֹם אֶתֹּ֖ץ אֶת־ הַמִּגְדָּ֥ל הַזֶּֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer gam- lə·’an·šê p̄ə·nū·’êl lê·mōr bə·šū·ḇî ḇə·šā·lō·wm ’et·tōṣ ’eṯ- ham·miḡ·dāl haz·zeh
verses.literal: So Gideon told the men of Penuel . . . When I return in triumph I will tear down this tower
verses.literalPt: Por isso também falou aos homens de Penuel, dizendo: Quando eu voltar em paz, derribarei esta torre.

verses.original: וְזֶ֨בַח וְצַלְמֻנָּ֜ע בַּקַּרְקֹ֗ר וּמַחֲנֵיהֶ֤ם עִמָּם֙ כַּחֲמֵ֤שֶׁת עָשָׂר֙ אֶ֔לֶף כֹּ֚ל הַנּ֣וֹתָרִ֔ים מִכֹּ֖ל מַחֲנֵ֣ה בְנֵי־ קֶ֑דֶם וְהַנֹּ֣פְלִ֔ים מֵאָ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ שֹׁ֥לֵֽף חָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ze·ḇaḥ wə·ṣal·mun·nā‘ baq·qar·qōr ū·ma·ḥă·nê·hem ‘im·mām ka·ḥă·mê·šeṯ ‘ā·śār ’e·lep̄ kōl han·nō·w·ṯā·rîm mik·kōl ma·ḥă·nêh ḇə·nê- qe·ḏem wə·han·nō·p̄ə·lîm mê·’āh wə·‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ ’îš šō·lêp̄ ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor with their army of about fifteen . . . thousand men all that were left of the armies of the people of the east A hundred and twenty thousand swordsmen . . . . . . had already fallen
verses.literalPt: Estavam, pois, Zeba e Salmuna em Carcor, e os seus exércitos com eles, uns quinze mil homens, todos os que restaram do exército dos filhos do oriente; e os que caíram foram cento e vinte mil homens, que puxavam da espada.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַל גִּדְע֗וֹן דֶּ֚רֶךְ הַשְּׁכוּנֵ֣י בָֽאֳהָלִ֔ים מִקֶּ֥דֶם לְנֹ֖בַח וְיָגְבֳּהָ֑ה וַיַּךְ֙ אֶת־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְהַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה הָ֥יָה בֶֽטַח׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al giḏ·‘ō·wn de·reḵ haš·šə·ḵū·nê ḇā·’o·hā·lîm miq·qe·ḏem lə·nō·ḇaḥ wə·yā·ḡə·bo·hāh way·yaḵ ’eṯ- ham·ma·ḥă·neh wə·ham·ma·ḥă·neh hā·yāh ḇe·ṭaḥ
verses.literal: And Gideon went up by way of the caravan . . . route east of Nobah and Jogbehah and he attacked their army taking them by surprise
verses.literalPt: E subiu Gideão pelo caminho dos que habitavam em tendas, para o oriente de Nobá e Jogbeá; e feriu aquele exército, porquanto o exército estava descuidado.

verses.original: וַיָּנ֗וּסוּ זֶ֚בַח וְצַלְמֻנָּ֔ע וַיִּרְדֹּ֖ף אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּלְכֹּ֞ד אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֣י׀ מַלְכֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן אֶת־ זֶ֙בַח֙ וְאֶת־ צַלְמֻנָּ֔ע וְכָל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה הֶחֱרִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·nū·sū ze·ḇaḥ wə·ṣal·mun·nā‘ way·yir·dōp̄ ’a·ḥă·rê·hem way·yil·kōḏ ’eṯ- šə·nê mal·ḵê miḏ·yān ’eṯ- ze·ḇaḥ wə·’eṯ- ṣal·mun·nā‘ wə·ḵāl ham·ma·ḥă·neh he·ḥĕ·rîḏ
verses.literal: When Zebah and Zalmunna fled Gideon pursued . . . and captured these two kings of Midian - - routing their entire army
verses.literalPt: E fugiram Zeba e Salmuna; porém ele os perseguiu, e tomou presos a ambos os reis dos midianitas, a Zeba e a Salmuna, e afugentou a todo o exército.

verses.original: וַיָּ֛שָׁב גִּדְע֥וֹן בֶּן־ יוֹאָ֖שׁ מִן־ הַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה מִֽלְמַעֲלֵ֖ה הֶחָֽרֶס׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ giḏ·‘ō·wn ben- yō·w·’āš min- ham·mil·ḥā·māh mil·ma·‘ă·lêh he·ḥā·res
verses.literal: After this, Gideon son of Joash returned from the battle along the Ascent of Heres
verses.literalPt: Voltando, pois, Gideão, filho de Joás, da peleja, antes do nascer do sol,

verses.original: וַיִּלְכָּד־ נַ֛עַר מֵאַנְשֵׁ֥י סֻכּ֖וֹת וַיִּשְׁאָלֵ֑הוּ וַיִּכְתֹּ֨ב אֵלָ֜יו אֶת־ שָׂרֵ֤י סֻכּוֹת֙ וְאֶת־ זְקֵנֶ֔יהָ שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָ֖ה אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yil·kāḏ- na·‘ar mê·’an·šê suk·kō·wṯ way·yiš·’ā·lê·hū way·yiḵ·tōḇ ’ê·lāw ’eṯ- śā·rê suk·kō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- zə·qê·ne·hā šiḇ·‘îm wə·šiḇ·‘āh ’îš
verses.literal: There he captured a young man . . . of Succoth and interrogated him The young man wrote down for him the names of the seventy-seven . . . leaders and elders of Succoth
verses.literalPt: Tomou preso a um moço dos homens de Sucote, e lhe fez perguntas; o qual lhe deu por escrito os nomes dos príncipes de Sucote, e dos seus anciãos, setenta e sete homens.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־ אַנְשֵׁ֣י סֻכּ֔וֹת וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּ֖ה זֶ֣בַח וְצַלְמֻנָּ֑ע אֲשֶׁר֩ חֵרַפְתֶּ֨ם אוֹתִ֜י לֵאמֹ֗ר הֲ֠כַף זֶ֣בַח וְצַלְמֻנָּ֤ע עַתָּה֙ בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ כִּ֥י נִתֵּ֛ן לַאֲנָשֶׁ֥יךָ הַיְּעֵפִ֖ים לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’el- ’an·šê suk·kō·wṯ way·yō·mer hin·nêh ze·ḇaḥ wə·ṣal·mun·nā‘ ’ă·šer ḥê·rap̄·tem ’ō·w·ṯî lê·mōr hă·ḵap̄ ze·ḇaḥ wə·ṣal·mun·nā‘ ‘at·tāh bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā kî nit·tên la·’ă·nā·še·ḵā hay·yə·‘ê·p̄îm lā·ḥem
verses.literal: And Gideon went to the men of Succoth and said Here are Zebah and Zalmunna about whom you taunted me saying Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna already in your possession that we should give bread to your weary men
verses.literalPt: Então veio aos homens de Sucote, e disse: Vede aqui a Zeba e a Salmuna, a respeito dos quais desprezivelmente me escarnecestes, dizendo: Estão já, Zeba e Salmuna, na tua mão, para que demos pão aos teus homens, já cansados?

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֙ אֶת־ זִקְנֵ֣י הָעִ֔יר וְאֶת־ קוֹצֵ֥י הַמִּדְבָּ֖ר וְאֶת־ הַֽבַּרְקֳנִ֑ים וַיֹּ֣דַע בָּהֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת אַנְשֵׁ֥י סֻכּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ziq·nê hā·‘îr wə·’eṯ- qō·w·ṣê ham·miḏ·bār wə·’eṯ- hab·bar·qo·nîm way·yō·ḏa‘ bā·hem ’êṯ ’an·šê suk·kō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then he took the elders of the city and using the thorns and briers of the wilderness - he disciplined the men of Succoth
verses.literalPt: E tomou os anciãos daquela cidade, e os espinhos do deserto, e os abrolhos; e com eles ensinou aos homens de Sucote.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ מִגְדַּ֥ל פְּנוּאֵ֖ל נָתָ֑ץ וַֽיַּהֲרֹ֖ג אֶת־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- miḡ·dal pə·nū·’êl nā·ṯāṣ way·ya·hă·rōḡ ’eṯ- ’an·šê hā·‘îr
verses.literal: He also pulled down the tower of Penuel and killed the men of the city
verses.literalPt: E derrubou a torre de Penuel, e matou os homens da cidade.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֶל־ זֶ֙בַח֙ וְאֶל־ צַלְמֻנָּ֔ע אֵיפֹה֙ הָאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲרַגְתֶּ֖ם בְּתָב֑וֹר וַֽיֹּאמרוּ֙ כָּמ֣וֹךָ כְמוֹהֶ֔ם אֶחָ֕ד כְּתֹ֖אַר בְּנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- ze·ḇaḥ wə·’el- ṣal·mun·nā‘ ’ê·p̄ōh hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer hă·raḡ·tem bə·ṯā·ḇō·wr way·yō·m·rū kā·mō·w·ḵā ḵə·mō·w·hem ’e·ḥāḏ kə·ṯō·’ar bə·nê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Next, Gideon asked . . . Zebah . . . and Zalmunna What kind of men did you kill at Tabor Men like you . . . they answered each one resembling the son of a king
verses.literalPt: Depois perguntou a Zeba e a Salmuna: Que homens eram os que matastes em Tabor? E disseram: Como és tu, assim eram eles; cada um parecia filho de rei.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֕ר אַחַ֥י בְּנֵֽי־ אִמִּ֖י הֵ֑ם חַי־ יְהוָ֗ה ל֚וּ הַחֲיִתֶ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ם לֹ֥א הָרַ֖גְתִּי אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar ’a·ḥay bə·nê- ’im·mî hêm ḥay- Yah·weh lū ha·ḥă·yi·ṯem ’ō·w·ṯām lō hā·raḡ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: They were my brothers Gideon replied the sons of my mother As surely as the LORD lives if you had let them live I would not kill you
verses.literalPt: Então disse ele: Meus irmãos eram, filhos de minha mãe; vive o SENHOR, que, se os tivésseis deixado com vida, eu não vos mataria.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לְיֶ֣תֶר בְּכוֹר֔וֹ ק֖וּם הֲרֹ֣ג אוֹתָ֑ם וְלֹא־ שָׁלַ֨ף הַנַּ֤עַר חַרְבּוֹ֙ כִּ֣י יָרֵ֔א כִּ֥י עוֹדֶ֖נּוּ נָֽעַר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·ye·ṯer bə·ḵō·w·rōw qūm hă·rōḡ ’ō·w·ṯām wə·lō- šā·lap̄ han·na·‘ar ḥar·bōw kî yā·rê kî ‘ō·w·ḏen·nū nā·‘ar
verses.literal: So he said to Jether his firstborn Get up and kill them But the young man did not draw his sword he was fearful because he was still a youth
verses.literalPt: E disse a Jeter, seu primogênito: Levanta-te, mata-os. Porém o moço não puxou da sua espada, porque temia; porquanto ainda era jovem.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֜אמֶר זֶ֣בַח וְצַלְמֻנָּ֗ע ק֤וּם אַתָּה֙ וּפְגַע־ בָּ֔נוּ כִּ֥י כָאִ֖ישׁ גְּבוּרָת֑וֹ וַיָּ֣קָם גִּדְע֗וֹן וַֽיַּהֲרֹג֙ אֶת־ זֶ֣בַח וְאֶת־ צַלְמֻנָּ֔ע וַיִּקַּח֙ אֶת־ הַשַּׂ֣הֲרֹנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּצַוְּארֵ֥י גְמַלֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ze·ḇaḥ wə·ṣal·mun·nā‘ qūm ’at·tāh ū·p̄ə·ḡa‘- bā·nū kî ḵā·’îš gə·ḇū·rā·ṯōw way·yā·qām giḏ·‘ō·wn way·ya·hă·rōḡ ’eṯ- ze·ḇaḥ wə·’eṯ- ṣal·mun·nā‘ way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- haś·śa·hă·rō·nîm ’ă·šer bə·ṣaw·wə·rê ḡə·mal·lê·hem
verses.literal: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said Get up and kill us yourself for as the man is so is his strength So Gideon got up and killed Zebah and Zalmunna and he took the crescent ornaments from the necks of their camels
verses.literalPt: Então disseram Zeba e Salmuna: Levanta-te, e acomete-nos; porque, qual o homem, tal a sua valentia. Levantou-se, pois, Gideão, e matou a Zeba e a Salmuna, e tomou os ornamentos que estavam nos pescoços dos seus camelos.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ אִֽישׁ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־ גִּדְע֔וֹן מְשָׁל־ בָּ֙נוּ֙ גַּם־ אַתָּ֔ה גַּם־ בִּנְךָ֖ גַּ֣ם בֶּן־ בְּנֶ֑ךָ כִּ֥י הוֹשַׁעְתָּ֖נוּ מִיַּ֥ד מִדְיָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’îš- yiś·rā·’êl ’el- giḏ·‘ō·wn mə·šāl- bā·nū gam- ’at·tāh gam- bin·ḵā gam ben- bə·ne·ḵā kî hō·wō·ša‘·tā·nū mî·yaḏ miḏ·yān
verses.literal: Then the Israelites . . . said to Gideon Rule over us you and your son . . . and grandson . . . for you have saved us from the hand of Midian
verses.literalPt: Então os homens de Israel disseram a Gideão: Domina sobre nós, tanto tu, como teu filho e o filho de teu filho; porquanto nos livraste da mão dos midianitas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ גִּדְע֔וֹן לֹֽא־ אֶמְשֹׁ֤ל אֲנִי֙ בָּכֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־ יִמְשֹׁ֥ל בְּנִ֖י בָּכֶ֑ם יְהוָ֖ה יִמְשֹׁ֥ל בָּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem giḏ·‘ō·wn lō- ’em·šōl ’ă·nî bā·ḵem wə·lō- yim·šōl bə·nî bā·ḵem Yah·weh yim·šōl bā·ḵem
verses.literal: But Gideon replied . . . I will not rule over you nor will my son The LORD shall rule over you
verses.literalPt: Porém Gideão lhes disse: Sobre vós eu não dominarei, nem tampouco meu filho sobre vós dominará; o SENHOR sobre vós dominará.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֜ם גִּדְע֗וֹן אֶשְׁאֲלָ֤ה מִכֶּם֙ שְׁאֵלָ֔ה וּתְנוּ־ לִ֕י אִ֖ישׁ נֶ֣זֶם שְׁלָל֑וֹ כִּֽי־ נִזְמֵ֤י זָהָב֙ לָהֶ֔ם כִּ֥י יִשְׁמְעֵאלִ֖ים הֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem giḏ·‘ō·wn ’eš·’ă·lāh mik·kem šə·’ê·lāh ū·ṯə·nū- lî ’îš ne·zem šə·lā·lōw kî- niz·mê zā·hāḇ lā·hem kî yiš·mə·‘ê·lîm hêm
verses.literal: Then he added Let me make a request . . . of you that each of you give me an earring from his plunder For the enemies had gold earrings because they were Ishmaelites
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes mais Gideão: Uma petição vos farei: Dá-me, cada um de vós, os pendentes do seu despojo (porque tinham pendentes de ouro, porquanto eram ismaelitas).

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ נָת֣וֹן נִתֵּ֑ן וַֽיִּפְרְשׂוּ֙ אֶת־ הַשִּׂמְלָ֔ה וַיַּשְׁלִ֣יכוּ שָׁ֔מָּה אִ֖ישׁ נֶ֥זֶם שְׁלָלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū nā·ṯō·wn nit·tên way·yip̄·rə·śū ’eṯ- haś·śim·lāh way·yaš·lî·ḵū šām·māh ’îš ne·zem šə·lā·lōw
verses.literal: We will give them gladly . . . they replied So they spread out a garment and each man threw an earring from his plunder onto it
verses.literalPt: E disseram eles: De boa vontade os daremos. E estenderam uma capa, e cada um deles deitou ali um pendente do seu despojo.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י מִשְׁקַ֞ל נִזְמֵ֤י הַזָּהָב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁאָ֔ל אֶ֥לֶף וּשְׁבַע־ מֵא֖וֹת זָהָ֑ב לְ֠בַד מִן־ הַשַּׂהֲרֹנִ֨ים וְהַנְּטִפ֜וֹת וּבִגְדֵ֣י הָאַרְגָּמָ֗ן שֶׁעַל֙ מַלְכֵ֣י מִדְיָ֔ן וּלְבַד֙ מִן־ הָ֣עֲנָק֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּצַוְּארֵ֥י גְמַלֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî miš·qal niz·mê haz·zā·hāḇ ’ă·šer šā·’āl ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·ḇa‘- mê·’ō·wṯ zā·hāḇ lə·ḇaḏ min- haś·śa·hă·rō·nîm wə·han·nə·ṭi·p̄ō·wṯ ū·ḇiḡ·ḏê hā·’ar·gā·mān še·‘al mal·ḵê miḏ·yān ū·lə·ḇaḏ min- hā·‘ă·nā·qō·wṯ ’ă·šer bə·ṣaw·wə·rê ḡə·mal·lê·hem
verses.literal: The weight of the gold earrings he had requested was 1 ,700 . . . . . . shekels in addition to . . . the crescent ornaments the pendants the purple garments of the kings of Midian . . . . . . and the chains from the necks of their camels
verses.literalPt: E foi o peso dos pendentes de ouro, que pediu, mil e setecentos siclos de ouro, afora os ornamentos, e as cadeias, e as vestes de púrpura que traziam os reis dos midianitas, e afora as coleiras que os camelos traziam ao pescoço.

verses.original: וַיַּעַשׂ֩ אוֹת֨וֹ גִדְע֜וֹן לְאֵפ֗וֹד וַיַּצֵּ֨ג אוֹת֤וֹ בְעִירוֹ֙ בְּעָפְרָ֔ה וַיִּזְנ֧וּ כָֽל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אַחֲרָ֖יו שָׁ֑ם וַיְהִ֛י לְגִדְע֥וֹן וּלְבֵית֖וֹ לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’ō·w·ṯōw ḡiḏ·‘ō·wn lə·’ê·p̄ō·wḏ way·yaṣ·ṣêḡ ’ō·w·ṯōw ḇə·‘î·rōw bə·‘ā·p̄ə·rāh way·yiz·nū ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl ’a·ḥă·rāw šām way·hî lə·ḡiḏ·‘ō·wn ū·lə·ḇê·ṯōw lə·mō·w·qêš
verses.literal: From all this Gideon made an ephod which he placed in Ophrah his hometown But soon all Israel prostituted themselves by worshiping it there and it became a snare to Gideon and his household
verses.literalPt: E fez Gideão dele um éfode, e colocou-o na sua cidade, em Ofra; e todo o Israel prostituiu-se ali após ele; e foi por tropeço a Gideão e à sua casa.

verses.original: וַיִּכָּנַ֣ע מִדְיָ֗ן לִפְנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלֹ֥א יָסְפ֖וּ לָשֵׂ֣את רֹאשָׁ֑ם וַתִּשְׁקֹ֥ט הָאָ֛רֶץ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בִּימֵ֥י גִדְעֽוֹן׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yik·kā·na‘ miḏ·yān lip̄·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō yā·sə·p̄ū lā·śêṯ rō·šām wat·tiš·qōṭ hā·’ā·reṣ ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh bî·mê ḡiḏ·‘ō·wn
verses.literal: In this way Midian was subdued before the Israelites . . . and did not raise its head again So the land had rest for forty years in the days of Gideon
verses.literalPt: Assim foram abatidos os midianitas diante dos filhos de Israel, e nunca mais levantaram a sua cabeça; e sossegou a terra quarenta anos nos dias de Gideão.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֛לֶךְ יְרֻבַּ֥עַל בֶּן־ יוֹאָ֖שׁ וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בְּבֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ yə·rub·ba·‘al ben- yō·w·’āš way·yê·šeḇ bə·ḇê·ṯōw
verses.literal: and he — Jerubbaal son of Joash returned home and settled down
verses.literalPt: E foi Jerubaal, filho de Joás, e habitou em sua casa.

verses.original: וּלְגִדְע֗וֹן הָיוּ֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים בָּנִ֔ים יֹצְאֵ֖י יְרֵכ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ נָשִׁ֥ים רַבּ֖וֹת הָ֥יוּ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḡiḏ·‘ō·wn hā·yū šiḇ·‘îm bā·nîm yō·ṣə·’ê yə·rê·ḵōw kî- nā·šîm rab·bō·wṯ hā·yū lōw
verses.literal: Gideon had seventy sons of his own . . . since he had many wives
verses.literalPt: E teve Gideão setenta filhos, que procederam dele, porque tinha muitas mulheres.

verses.original: וּפִֽילַגְשׁוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁכֶ֔ם יָֽלְדָה־ לּ֥וֹ גַם־ הִ֖יא בֵּ֑ן וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄î·laḡ·šōw ’ă·šer biš·ḵem yā·lə·ḏāh- lōw ḡam- hî bên way·yā·śem ’eṯ- šə·mōw ’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ
verses.literal: His concubine who dwelt in Shechem also . . . bore him a son and he named him Abimelech
verses.literalPt: E sua concubina, que estava em Siquém, lhe deu à luz também um filho; e pôs-lhe por nome Abimeleque.

verses.original: וַיָּ֛מָת גִּדְע֥וֹן בֶּן־ יוֹאָ֖שׁ בְּשֵׂיבָ֣ה טוֹבָ֑ה וַיִּקָּבֵ֗ר בְּקֶ֙בֶר֙ יוֹאָ֣שׁ אָבִ֔יו בְּעָפְרָ֖ה אֲבִ֥י הָֽעֶזְרִֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ giḏ·‘ō·wn ben- yō·w·’āš bə·śê·ḇāh ṭō·w·ḇāh way·yiq·qā·ḇêr bə·qe·ḇer yō·w·’āš ’ā·ḇîw bə·‘ā·p̄ə·rāh ’ă·ḇî hā·‘ez·rî
verses.literal: Later, Gideon son of Joash died at a ripe old age and was buried in the tomb of his father Joash in Ophrah of the Abiezrites
verses.literalPt: E faleceu Gideão, filho de Joás, numa boa velhice; e foi sepultado no sepulcro de seu pai Joás, em Ofra dos abiezritas.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ מֵ֣ת גִּדְע֔וֹן וַיָּשׁ֙וּבוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּזְנ֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֣י הַבְּעָלִ֑ים וַיָּשִׂ֧ימוּ לָהֶ֛ם בַּ֥עַל בְּרִ֖ית לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer mêṯ giḏ·‘ō·wn way·yā·šū·ḇū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yiz·nū ’a·ḥă·rê hab·bə·‘ā·lîm way·yā·śî·mū lā·hem ba·‘al bə·rîṯ lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: And as soon as Gideon was dead the Israelites . . . turned and prostituted themselves with the Baals and they set up Baal-berith as their god
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, como Gideão faleceu, os filhos de Israel tornaram a se prostituir após os baalins; e puseram a Baal-Berite por deus.

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א זָֽכְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם הַמַּצִּ֥יל אוֹתָ֛ם מִיַּ֥ד כָּל־ אֹיְבֵיהֶ֖ם מִסָּבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō zā·ḵə·rū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem ham·maṣ·ṣîl ’ō·w·ṯām mî·yaḏ kāl- ’ō·yə·ḇê·hem mis·sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . failed to remember the LORD their God who had delivered them from the hands of all their enemies on every side
verses.literalPt: E assim os filhos de Israel não se lembraram do SENHOR seu Deus, que os livrara da mão de todos os seus inimigos ao redor.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ עָשׂ֣וּ חֶ֔סֶד עִם־ בֵּ֥ית יְרֻבַּ֖עַל גִּדְע֑וֹן כְּכָל־ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה עִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ‘ā·śū ḥe·seḏ ‘im- bêṯ yə·rub·ba·‘al giḏ·‘ō·wn kə·ḵāl- haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ‘im- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: They did not show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal (that is, Gideon for all the good things he had done for Israel
verses.literalPt: Nem usaram de beneficência com a casa de Jerubaal, a saber, de Gideão, conforme a todo o bem que ele havia feito a Israel.
